ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the amounts lost to fraudulent claims and the efforts being made to prevent future fraud
questions: How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What efforts are being made to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the need for increased oversight and enforcement in the Medicaid system, and could potentially lead to reforms that prevent future fraud
